units.source_text: 金属板棋盘有磁力，可以将棋子吸住，即使在火车上对局，也很方便。

en.t: The metal board was magnetic and could hold the pieces in place, so it was convenient even for playing a game on the train.

units.source_text: 但一合上，就不知道是什么玩意儿。

en.t: But once it was folded shut, you could no longer tell what the thing was.

units.source_text: 我携带着它奔东走西倒也方便。

en.t: It was also convenient for me to carry it around wherever I went.
